report_content:
X-ray shoulder Joint AP and lateral views

 

Findings:

 

No bony lesion is seen.

The metadiaphyseal areas are normal.

Bone density appears normal.

The lateral, medial and superior border of the scapula appears to be intact.

Surgical neck of the humerus is intact.

Gleno-humoral and acromio-clavicular joint space appears to be maintained.

Articular margins are normal.

No abnormal soft tissue shadow is noted.

 

 

IMPRESSION:

No significant abnormality noted.
